name: alakazam_ml_v12
model: The v11 LightGBM ranker and features are inherited unchanged and remain shadow-only; v12 changes deterministic policy only.
model_scope: Deterministic policy owns setup, draw activation, trainer, energy, evolution, attack, retreat, Boss, Hammer, Fezandipiti, Shaymin, Xerosic, and end decisions. The ranker can only shadow-score guarded Abra bench choices unless explicitly enabled for an experiment.
deck_policy: Keep the submitted v10 60-card list: 2 Basic Psychic plus 4 Telepath Psychic, 3 Dunsparce / 2 Dudunsparce, Shaymin, Fezandipiti ex, 3 Rare Candy, 4 Enhanced Hammer, 3 Boss's Orders, and Max Rod.

top_alakazam_replays.conclusion: Top lists are structurally close, so sequencing and attack continuity are the first intervention; deck edits require separate gates.

v11_rule_changes: Choose Dunsparce as the opening Active when both Abra and Dunsparce are available.
Prefer Rare Candy into Alakazam when its three-card evolution draw produces the first same-turn attack or an immediate KO.
Score the Rare Candy source target so a fueled Active Abra is selected over a stranded Bench route.
Value evolving the Bench Abra to Kadabra when its two-card draw can find Rare Candy for the Active Abra.
Treat Kadabra and Alakazam evolution draws as net hand gain in lethal-preservation checks.
Permit a low-deck Dudunsparce/evolution draw for Psychic Energy only with at least 50% public-information hit probability and immediate loss pressure.
Limit Fezandipiti energy investment to a one-attachment-away concrete 100-damage prize route or a same-turn pivot.
Bench Shaymin only for a payable Active spread attack that threatens a non-rule-box Bench Pokemon within two attacks.
Keep mirror Xerosic thresholds while requiring a nine-card developing-board target outside the mirror.
v12_rule_changes: Use Abra's effect card in SWITCH context to separate Teleport selection from ordinary KO promotion and retreat selection.
After Teleport, prefer Dunsparce, Dudunsparce, or a spare Abra; allow Fezandipiti at comparable priority only when a public-information next-turn KO check says it is likely safe.
Keep Kadabra and both Alakazam cards as mandatory-only Teleport targets when more than one Bench choice exists.
Apply Team Rocket's Articuno protection only to Basic Team Rocket Pokemon, not Team Rocket Evolutions or unrelated Pokemon.
Use Boss's Orders for a same-turn KO on an unprotected Evolution or non-Team-Rocket Bench target when the opposing Active is Articuno-protected.
When every visible opponent is protected by Articuno, gradually fund Fezandipiti as the primary damage attacker, then Dudunsparce, Dunsparce, or Shaymin as single-prize fallbacks.
Retreat or switch into a ready damage-based breaker, prioritize Articuno with Cruel Arrow, and reject Powerful Hand or zero-damage Trading Places into the complete lock.
ml_feature_changes: correct Psychic-providing Energy identity instead of treating Enriching Energy as Psychic
public-information draw-2 and draw-3 Psychic Energy hit probabilities
Kadabra/Alakazam evolution draw and net hand delta
Rare Candy projected post-draw damage and immediate KO
known_limitations: The v10 ranker is intentionally not retrained on v10 losses because those trajectories are failure evidence, not expert action labels.
Deck order variance remains; v12 changes two requested tactical branches rather than claiming to remove opening-hand variance.
